title: Segmentation fault in import_source.cpp during loading model via C++ API

labels.name: oncall: jit
labels.description: Add this issue/PR to JIT oncall triage queue

labels.name: module: crash
labels.description: Problem manifests as a hard crash, as opposed to a RuntimeError

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

Hi!

I found a segmentation fault in torch::jit::load() C++ API when loading a corrupted model. The bug was found with fuzzing.


File to reproduce: [crash.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/15550662/crash.zip)
